data: Which of the following lines has the highest F1 score at 25k labeled Chinese QA pairs?

The question asks for the line with the highest F1 score at 25k labeled Chinese QA pairs. From the analysis of the figure, the vertical axis represents the F1 score, and the horizontal axis represents the number of labeled Chinese QA pairs in thousands. At 25k labeled Chinese QA pairs, the blue line (SQuAD GAN-CH) appears to be the highest among the three lines. Therefore, the answer is SQuAD GAN-CH.
